issues.description: Two brief product summaries (Gamma, Beautiful.ai) make comparative claims but are marked only as 'general background knowledge' and lack KB citations. This is allowed per the grounding rules, but the statements could be either cited or further qualified to avoid readers assuming they come from the provided KB.
issues.required_fix: Either add supporting citations from the KB for Gamma and Beautiful.ai features, or keep the descriptions explicitly labeled and terser as 'general background knowledge'. If factual specifics are added, provide retrieved excerpts.

issues.description: The note that some Designer features apply only to private Microsoft accounts appears in a footnote attached to the practical example rather than next to the paragraph that lists the features. Readers might miss this limitation when skimming the features.
issues.required_fix: Move or duplicate the account‑limitation note so it immediately follows the feature list sentence describing Designer's AI features (or add an inline parenthetical), ensuring the constraint is visible where features are introduced.

issues.description: Multiple footnotes labeled 'General background knowledge' are used. While not incorrect LaTeX, repeating identical simple footnotes can be noisy in the rendered document and may be better handled by a single consolidated note or by in‑text parenthetical tags.
issues.required_fix: Consider consolidating repeated 'General background knowledge' footnotes into a single footnote at the start or end of the compact comparison, or convert them to an in‑text parenthetical remark for concision.
